## What it catches

A package file outside `src/adapters/` importing `effect/unstable/sql`, `@effect/sql-*`, `@effect/platform-*`, or a workspace package listed in `adapterImports` (always an error).

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "adapter-imports-only-in-adapters",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^packages/[^/]+/src/",
    "pathNot": [
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/adapters(?:/|$)"
    ]
  },
  "to": {
    "path": [
      "(?:^|/)node_modules/effect/(?:[^/]+/|)unstable/sql(?:[/.]|$)",
      "(?:^|/)node_modules/@effect/sql-[^/]*/",
      "(?:^|/)node_modules/@effect/platform-[^/]*/"
    ]
  }
}
```
